title: Metrics for Dataset Demographic Bias: A Case Study on Facial Expression Recognition
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not analyze any aspects of religion or faith. It proposes a taxonomy of metrics to measure demographic bias (specifically representational and stereotypical bias) in datasets, using Facial Expression Recognition (FER) as a case study. The demographic characteristics analyzed are age, race, and gender.
findings: The paper does not analyze any aspects of religion or faith.
